WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_signals
  FROM signals
)
SELECT tc.telescref,
       tc.signal_count,
       tc.signal_count::numeric / NULLIF(t.total_signals, 0) AS signal_fraction
FROM telescope_counts AS tc
CROSS JOIN total AS t
ORDER BY signal_fraction DESC, tc.telescref
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Share is each telescope’s signal count divided by the total number of rows in signals; telescopes with no detected signals are excluded because they have no signals row.
